saints.name: St. Cloud
saints.title: Priest and Hermit
saints.shortBlurb: A Frankish prince who escaped his brothers' murder, renounced a crown, and chose the poverty of a priest and hermit…
biography: Cloud (Clodoald) was a grandson of King Clovis and Queen St. Clotilde. When his uncles murdered his two brothers to seize their inheritance, the boy Cloud was spared and carried to safety. Renouncing all claim to the throne, he embraced the religious life.

He became a hermit and priest near Paris, gathering disciples and serving the poor, and died about 560 at the place afterward called Saint-Cloud in his honour. His life was long remembered as a royal soul who chose Christ over a kingdom.
saints.knownFor: Trading his royal inheritance for the life of a hermit and priest.
